text:
Aisha: customer report - console shows provisional > confirmed after a stream reconnect + retried toolcall. Sending sanitized trace.

Tom: can you paste the trace id?

Aisha: sanitized trace:
req=cli-7f2, events=[start, chunk(100), disconnect, resume(session=s-11), chunk(50), toolcall(start,id=tc-9), toolcall(truncate), retry(toolcall,id=tc-9-r1), end], provisional=290, confirmed=180

Ravi: sounds like the truncated fragment from the first session was credited then the retry credited again. Root cause: origin_session_id was dropped on handoff so ledger can't dedupe.

Sasha: proposal: add `provisional` flag + `origin_session_id` and `toolcall_attempt_id` to telemetry/ledger events. Reconcile confirmed charges by matching (origin_session_id, token_end). Also add provisional TTL ~2m to auto-expire.

Tom: short-term UX mitigator: show per-route "Tentative" badge with hover "Includes provisional tokens pending final ack; may adjust in ~1-3m" to reduce Ops noise.

Ravi: I'll draft an RFD for ledger dedupe rules and metrics (provisional_confirm_count, provisional_refund_amount). Hold refunds policy until we see telemetry.

Sasha: router currently drops origin_session on compat handoff. I'll push a small shim to preserve it (1-2d).

deploy-bot: canary deploy for router-shim completed (commit e3b9f2) :white_check_mark:

Aisha: thanks. Follow-ups: Ravi=RFD, Sasha=shim+PR, Tom=integration test + console tooltip. I'll attach the customer's sanitized bundle when available. :thumbsup:
